summary.text: Dan Howell is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 22 since 2014, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Howell's professional experience includes working as executive assistant to the mayor of Bradley County, serving on the Bradley County Chamber of Commerce Board, the Cleveland/Bradley Greenway Board, and the Storm Water Advisory Board, and serving on the Tennessee Republican Party State Executive Committee.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Transportation Committee and was also assigned to the Calendar and Rules, Criminal Justice, and Fiscal Review committees.
